source: OverTheCap via nflverse historical_contracts.csv (snapshot 2022-05-29); amounts are APY as a share of that year's cap; veteran = not a rookie deal; age = at signing (birth date, else draft year + 22)

notes.vet_minimum_rule: veteran minimums are ~0.4-0.6% of the cap; a 4+ year vet on a 1-year minimum deal counts only ~0.4% (veteran salary benefit)
